title: Implement Shared Love Garden visualization feature

requirements.text: Create a Love Garden visualization component that displays a progressive garden scene starting as a small seed/sapling and evolving into a lush garden based on relationship milestones

quotes: Proceed with the love garden feature
a visual representation of your relationship's growth that evolves with every ritual and activity completed
Start as a small seed/sapling and grow into a lush garden

acceptanceCriteria: Garden component renders a visual scene that changes appearance based on progression level
Visual progression includes multiple growth stages from seed to full garden
Component integrates with existing romantic theme and color scheme

requirements.text: Tie Love Garden growth progression to the existing XP system, streak milestones, and badge achievements so that completing rituals and activities visibly advances the garden

quotes: evolves with every ritual and activity completed
Tie directly to your XP and streak systems
Add new plants, flowers, or trees based on milestones

acceptanceCriteria: Garden visual updates when XP increases from ritual completions
New plants or garden elements appear at specific streak milestones (3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 100 days)
Badge achievements trigger visible changes in the garden
Garden state persists across sessions and page refreshes

requirements.text: Add a dedicated Love Garden page accessible from the main navigation that displays the full garden visualization with current growth status

quotes: a visual representation of your relationship's growth

acceptanceCriteria: New navigation tab added to BottomNav component for Love Garden
Garden page is accessible to authenticated and paired users
Page displays the garden visualization prominently
Page shows current progress indicators (XP, streak, level)

requirements.text: Create gentle, rewarding animations when garden elements grow or new plants appear to make progress feel magical and emotionally resonant

quotes: Feel gentle, rewarding, and emotionally resonant

acceptanceCriteria: Smooth transition animations when garden progresses to next stage
New plant appearances include celebration animations
Animation timing feels gentle and not jarring

requirements.text: Store and persist Love Garden state in the backend including current garden level, unlocked plants, and milestone tracking
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores garden progression data for each couple
Garden state can be queried via backend API
Garden progression updates when rituals/challenges are completed
State persists correctly across backend upgrades

constraints: Must integrate with existing XP, streak, and badge systems without modifying their core logic
Garden visualization must fit within the existing romantic theme and color palette
Must work with current authentication and pairing requirements
Must respect accessibility preferences including reduced motion
Backend must follow single-actor architecture in main.mo
nonGoals: Multiplayer or social sharing features for the garden
Customization options for garden appearance or themes
Mini-games or interactive elements within the garden
Garden comparison features between different couples
External integrations or third-party garden templates

required: Garden seed/sprout illustration for initial stage (garden-seed.dim_200x200.png)
Young sapling illustration for early growth stage (garden-sapling.dim_300x300.png)
Small garden with flowers illustration for mid-level stage (garden-flowers.dim_400x400.png)
Lush garden with multiple plants and trees illustration for advanced stage (garden-lush.dim_500x500.png)
Blooming rose bush illustration for milestone unlock (rose-bush.dim_150x150.png)
Cherry blossom tree illustration for high streak milestone (cherry-blossom.dim_200x250.png)
